inputs.text: Wake up and look past the surface script they are feeding the public about a normal political debate in Israel’s parliament regarding a Bill for the death penalty as the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. That is just a distraction from the real choreography. It is a total victory for Itamar Ben-Gvir, the far-right Minister of National Security and leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. Do not believe for a second that the opposition is actually standing against them. When opponents call it racist, draconian and unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants, that is merely controlled opposition playing their assigned roles in this theater to create the illusion of a real struggle behind closed doors. It is all coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites pulling the strings.
